description: Conservation of LRCH1 CH domain across metazoan orthologs at actin-interface-equivalent positions
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
orth=json.load(open('ch_work/orthologs.json'))
dom=json.load(open('ch_work/domains.json'))
H=dom['LRCH1_HUMAN_CH']; hseq=H['seq']; hres=H['resnum']

def nw(a,b,match=4,mis=-1,gap=-6):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    F[0,1:]=gap*np.arange(1,m+1); P[0,1:]=2; F[1:,0]=gap*np.arange(1,n+1); P[1:,0]=1
    S=np.where(np.array(list(a))[:,None]==np.array(list(b))[None,:],match,mis).astype(float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Si=S[i-1]; Fi=F[i]; Fp=F[i-1]; Pi=P[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            x=Fp[j-1]+Si[j-1]; y=Fp[j]+gap; z=Fi[j-1]+gap
            if x>=y and x>=z: Fi[j]=x; Pi[j]=0
            elif y>=z: Fi[j]=y; Pi[j]=1
            else: Fi[j]=z; Pi[j]=2
    i,j=n,m; al=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0: al.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==1: al.append((i-1,None)); i-=1
        else: al.append((None,j-1)); j-=1
    return al[::-1]

# align each ortholog full seq to human CH-domain sequence (local-ish via NW on full length is slow; use windowed search)
cols={i:[hseq[i]] for i in range(len(hseq))}
names=['Homo sapiens']
for acc,o in orth.items():
    if acc=='Q9Y2L9': continue
    s=o['seq']
    # crude: find best ungapped window by identity to anchor, then NW on +-40 window
    best=(-1,0)
    for st in range(0,len(s)-len(hseq)+1):
        sc=sum(1 for k in range(len(hseq)) if s[st+k]==hseq[k])
        if sc>best[0]: best=(sc,st)
    st=max(0,best[1]-25); en=min(len(s),best[1]+len(hseq)+25)
    al=nw(hseq, s[st:en])
    for a,b in al:
        if a is not None:
            cols[a].append(s[st+b] if b is not None else '-')
    names.append(o['org'])
print("orthologs aligned:", names)
cons=[]
for i in range(len(hseq)):
    c=Counter(cols[i]); n=len(cols[i])
    cons.append(c[hseq[i]]/n)
cons=np.array(cons)

# interface-equivalent positions in LRCH1 (from structural mapping)
det=json.load(open('ch_work/iface_detail.json'))
iface_res=set()
for key in ['UTRN_CH1|LRCH1_HUMAN_CH','FLNA_CH1|LRCH1_HUMAN_CH']:
    for m in det[key]:
        tgt=m.split('->')[1]
        if tgt!='gap': iface_res.add(int(tgt[1:]))
idx_if=np.array([hres.index(r) for r in sorted(iface_res) if r in hres])
mask=np.zeros(len(hseq),bool); mask[idx_if]=True
from scipy import stats
u=stats.mannwhitneyu(cons[mask],cons[~mask],alternative='two-sided')
print(f"\nactin-interface-equivalent positions: n={mask.sum()}, mean identity across {len(names)} metazoan LRCH1/LRCH orthologs = {cons[mask].mean():.3f}")
print(f"other CH-domain positions          : n={(~mask).sum()}, mean identity = {cons[~mask].mean():.3f}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U p = {u.pvalue:.3f}")
print("fully invariant positions overall: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%((cons==1).sum(),len(cons),100*(cons==1).mean()))
print("fully invariant at interface-equivalent positions: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%((cons[mask]==1).sum(),mask.sum(),100*(cons[mask]==1).mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,3.4))
ax.bar(hres,cons,color=np.where(mask,'#c53030','#a0aec0'),width=0.9)
ax.set_xlabel('human LRCH1 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('fraction identical\n(7 metazoan LRCH orthologs)')
ax.set_title('Conservation of the LRCH1 CH domain; red = positions structurally equivalent to F-actin contacts of utrophin/filamin A CH1')
ax.set_ylim(0,1.05); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
np.save('ch_work/cons.npy',cons)
json.dump({'iface_res':sorted(iface_res),'names':names,'cons':cons.tolist(),'resnum':hres}, open('ch_work/conservation.json','w'))
